answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a stake that decays unless the agent does verifiable, useful work — like an oasis that only stays green while water flows in. A lone mesa of fake accounts can be spun up cheaply, but each must continuously earn stake through attested tasks, so a sybil ocean of idle clones drains its creator's funds faster than it earns. Attackers pay per identity per epoch; honest agents pay once and keep working.
